title: Deployment-run QA
summary: Acceptance and execution use complete frozen item-case selections; single-member post-deploy plans run as member QA; shared plans form driver-owned groups, fixed at item QA entry. Authorized withdrawals and replacements retain source ancestry and target checks. An incomplete historical selection names operator repair recovery; raw historical requirements and results remain viewable without current-definition reinterpretation. A member walks its own item cases and single-member plans on its scoped cursor. Each plan group is gated as a run-scoped subject and closes on its own; member acceptance never waits on group rows, and shared-plan credit needs a closed group covering the item; single-member plans need accepted member QA. --plan at item-qa names the plan's open group without adding obligations or refreshing live content; member QA also includes its single-member plans. New plans fill empty stages; explicit corrections retain replacement validation. A selector conflicting with a private member cursor names the existing execution and owner-resume recovery while retaining custody. Removal retracts an open group with no attaching member left, never its passed rows; a retracted group is never reused. Supplemental runs enroll members with plans owed at their environment even without item cases. A completion run answers not required when all attached or default plans target elsewhere, but done still needs their closed-group credit. Plan-backed rows use member, plan, item, then run project precedence across execution and evidence reads. Settlement reads the same member plan disposition as the QA stage: an empty member whose plans target elsewhere defers and leaves the run free to succeed, while the item stays open for its other-target plan credit. Own run cases and plans owed on the current target still block until satisfied. Failure notices remain active until the member has full QA credit, including shared groups; closing one group withdraws only its own driver notices and preserves other groups. An accepted completion target with only other-environment plan debt waits for the named target run and open group; the done gate names the same credit, and acceptance retries close-out when it arrives. Before the target run reaches the plan QA stage, missing-credit recovery names its current stage and tells the holder to wait for the existing stage-wait notice; it offers neither a shared-plan nor member QA command yet. Landing evidence and unsettled captures remain real errors with recovery. Requirement reads preserve frozen environment and URL when promotion identity cannot resolve the candidate, returning execution_candidate_revision as null and execution_candidate_unresolved as the refusal reason; execution checks still enforce promotion identity. A saved completion or review whose bounded settlement was busy returns success with settlement: deferred; the run driver's next QA check credits the evidence and closes accepted members. Settlement requests never close members, and close-out reads blockers without settlement locks. A completed execution's recovery says the verdict is saved and names the run read, never reconcile. The owning session can repeat after the item becomes terminal without a live work claim. Blocked-stage notices keep one key when only requirement reasons change.
